[STAGE-TRIAGE 2026-07-29 -> OUT-OF-SCOPE / EXTERNAL] The core ask targets backlogit's OWN internal active->queued transition guard/self-repair. backlogit is an external binary (C:\Tools\backlogit.exe, v1.7.0); its source is NOT in this autoharness repo (no Go/backlogit source present), so the internal guard/self-repair cannot be implemented here -- route upstream to the backlogit project. POSSIBLE IN-REPO MITIGATION (separate, speculative -- needs a spike, NOT staged now): the autoharness Ship agent (.github/agents/_ship.agent.md) is what claims shipments (backlogit_claim_shipment at build start) -- a Ship-workflow preflight that (a) reliably records the active claim and (b) detects a queued-with-active-work inconsistency could mitigate the symptom without touching backlogit internals. Kept in stash tagged EXTERNAL; not forced into a shipment. ORIGINAL: Backlogit active->queued transition-guard hardening: a shipment (observed on 103-S during the Ship-101s memory note) stayed 'queued' because the build loop never committed an 'active' claim; recovery required a manual archived-status surgical fix. Add a guard/invariant so an in-progress build reliably records the active claim, or so the queued-with-active-work inconsistency is detected and self-repaired instead of requiring a manual fix.

[CROSS-REPO INTAKE from backlogit orchestrator, 2026-07-30] Harden the harness for multi-shipment dark-factory sequencing so the orchestrator can parcel a chosen/calculated sequence of shipments one-by-one during a long-running P-017 dark run. Three coordinated template changes:

(1) templates/agents/_orchestrator.agent.md.tmpl -- Shipment-selection rule (currently "Select the highest-priority queued shipment", under-specified because shipments rarely carry priority). Make it queue-ordering-aware: honor custom_fields.queue_position and suppress shipments with unresolved blocking item_deps, so an item_deps blocks-chain across shipments becomes a self-enforcing sequence and the orchestrator just claims the top of `queue view --type shipment --status queued`.

(2) templates/policies/workflow-policies.md.tmpl -- P-017 DARK_MODE_SCOPE: record the ORDERED shipment scope plus resume/audit evidence so a long-running dark run has an authoritative, restartable sequence without a new scheduler.

(3) templates/instructions/backlogit.instructions.md.tmpl -- backlogit capability-pack overlay: add a shipment-sequencing playbook (`queue view --type shipment --status queued`; `dep add <next> <prev> --type blocks` to chain; note dep_type collapses to blocks on sync/rehydrate).

Grounding: backlogit spike 001-SP (docs/decisions/2026-07-29-ship-sequence-manifest-spike.md) concluded DEFER a standalone ship_sequence.jsonl and prefer reuse of queue + item_deps. This intake is the upstream (autoharness template) counterpart; backlogit product-side gaps are tracked separately in backlogit stash 0B5FA82B.
